content: Mike was injured this morning, did he have a car accident?
No, what made you think so?
He started driving only a week ago, so I thought he might have had a car accident.
He got his driver's license 3 years ago, he is actually a skilled driver.
He went to play basketball this morning, he ran too fast and he was knocked over.
Is that how he got injured?
Yes, I was playing tennis nearby, I took him to the hospital.
